test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following agencies has undertaken the Golden Quadrilateral project?

options.text: National Highways and Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited

solution:
The correct answer is __**National Highways Authority of India.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Highways Authority of India:-**

 
 
• The National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) has undertaken the Golden Quadrilateral project.
 
• The project involves the construction of a 5,846 km network of highways connecting the four major cities of Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, and Kolkata.
 
• The project was initiated in 2001 and completed in 2012 at a cost of around undefined300 billion (US$4.2 billion).
 
• The Golden Quadrilateral project is one of the largest highway construction projects in the world.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Highways and Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited:-**

 
 
• NHIDCL is a public sector undertaking that was established in 2014 to promote, develop, and maintain infrastructure projects in the country.
 
 
 
• **Indian Roads Construction Corporation:-**
 
 
• IRCON is a government-owned infrastructure company that was established in 1976 to undertake construction projects in India and abroad. 
 
 
 
• **Border Road Organisation:-**
 
 
• BRO is a branch of the Indian Army that is responsible for the construction and maintenance of roads in border areas.
